blurb: Guests meet at a pre-determined location before sunrise or three hours before sunset. The balloon is assembled and inflated, then passengers enjoy a silent flight lasting 45 minutes to 1 hour 20 minutes over the countryside. After landing, the balloon is packed up and guests share a toast to conclude the experience, totaling about three hours from meeting to finish.
